title: Eastern-Based House of Representatives Removes Speaker Aguila Saleh After 12 Years
detail: Libya's eastern-based House of Representatives voted on October 7, 2026 to remove Speaker Aguila Saleh Issa, who had held the post since 2014, amid growing discontent among lawmakers. Anadolu reports the chamber elected Al-Salihin Abdul Nabi al-Obeidi as his replacement, after members amended internal rules to limit the speaker and deputies to a single 12-month term. The National noted optimism that the change will help unify the country remains muted.
